rationale: Rahul and Rafael both work at the intersection of computer vision and autonomous systems—Rahul deploying robotic solutions for agricultural field labor at AgRobotics, and Rafael building real-time ML systems for construction automation at Boon AI. Rafael's expertise in Python and TensorFlow could be valuable for enhancing the perception and decision-making capabilities of AgRobotics' robotic systems, while Rahul's hands-on experience deploying robots in real-world field environments offers practical insights for scaling ML solutions in similarly unstructured, outdoor settings.
intro_message: Rahul, meet Rafael — you're both building computer vision and autonomous systems for heavy industries (agriculture and construction), and Rafael's ML engineering background could complement AgRobotics' robotics deployment work.
